title: Report a post on your test Page and watch it hide
look: Report is on the menu of a post, its photo, the Page picture, the Page's words and a featured item; Send stays off until you pick a reason and type words
A plain note says misuse counts against you
Picking "threat of harm" shows a call-911-first note
After Send the sheet closes with a thank-you
Open the Page signed out: it is already hidden

title: Answer the notice about your hidden post
role: the owner of your test Page
look: The notice names the category, the reporter's reason and a kind explanation
"Fix it and repost" puts the post back at once, and a second repost is not offered
"This is wrong" asks for a reason and a note that stops at 280
A second answer is refused; the item stays hidden until a person decides
Leave it unanswered: the post stays hidden and closes by itself later

title: See your report in the review list
look: Your report text is in the list, in one easy phone view
Open its detail: the AI line shows an outcome, a confidence number and a short reason
A low-risk report keeps its status; the AI note does not hide or restore it
You are offered Remove photo on a Page with a photo; the owner and a member are not
Change a decision: it takes effect and the earlier ones stay listed in order

title: Clear the review list with one tap each
look: Signed out, the review page says "couldn't find that" and nothing else
Most serious comes first and the counts at the top match
Approve and Remove are two wide thumb-sized buttons; drag right = Approve, left = Remove
Most serious asks once more; lower ones just decide; Undo within five seconds brings the row back
After a decision the next row slides up; the reason is already filled in

title: Add a photo to your Page and meet the no-children check
role: the owner of your test Page
look: You cannot use the photo until you tick that it has no children
A sensitive-content question shows while you upload
The "add something to sell" screen opens with a short kind note asking for nothing sensitive
The Page picture is optional
A Page with no picture yet shows its kind's picture on the Page, on Explore and on its posts

title: Join the waitlist for a city that is not open yet
look: The city list is long, open cities first under their own heading
A closed city shows how many more people are needed, one number everywhere, with no date and no promise; nothing on the screen says "metro"
Creator and patron both start unselected
You join with only an email: no password, no name
After joining, a popup shows the count and a short message; join twice with the same email, or switch city: the count moves once

title: Look at Explore as a visitor who has not signed in
look: One card per Page; the count says "this week", never "0"
Cards show photo, name, count, a details line and a sign-in call; no post text, time or place; a Page with no photo shows its kind's picture
A Page shows name, photo, description and a sign-in card; no location, tags or founder
Tapping around a card only ever asks you to sign in
Only display names show; no real full names anywhere

title: Sign up from a Sacramento zip
look: After the email code, you land on a profile step that asks for your legal name, display name, zip and an 18+ box; you cannot skip it
Try to leave the legal name empty: you are kept on the step
The Sacramento zip names your metro and says the zip chose it
A short line says what the app is for, with nothing about never selling
Nobody asks whether you make things or look for things

title: Publish a Page and agree to the rules
look: The rules are fixed sentences; one box is all, no upload or ID; "No pictures of children." is on the rules page
A draft saves fine; only Publish needs the box ticked
A blank draft lists what is needed; the photo says optional
No business, legal or tax words anywhere
Starting a second Page asks you to agree again

title: Find your way around Explore
look: Explore is its own screen; a Map switch is within reach and works both ways
One filter icon, no chip rows, nothing between the cards; a dot shows while a filter is on
Each card shows the name people know that Page by
Search, open a result, go back: same city, same search, same scroll place
A group or gathering Page opens normally

title: See what is happening today and this week
look: Today and this-week rows hold only posts starting in that window, soonest first
Empty rows do not show, and a quiet city drops the whole heading
Your own items show for you, and change when you change the metro
Signed out, each posting Page gives one "sign in to see" card; signed in, the full posts are back
Open the same link on another phone: the same rows show

title: Scroll and watch the bottom bar
look: Scrolling down slides the bar away smoothly; scrolling up a little brings it back
At the very top it is showing, and on a fresh tab load
Content does not jump
Home and You behave the same way
Icons are thin and filled when active, on an opaque white bar with a hairline top border

title: Start something without opening a shop
look: You is free of "vendor", "market" and "business owner"; a Start something link shows
Create asks one question, picking a kind lands you on a draft, and nobody asks legal, tax or ID questions
After your first Page, one tap starts another and the first is untouched
Every Page you started is listed, drafts too
The old Following address lands on the Following list

title: Fill in your Page: basics, address, tags and phone
role: the owner of your test Page
look: Edit opens with your picture, name and about already filled; a change shows on the Page
A real address shows a pin; a nonsense one is refused with a message
Pick a neighbourhood instead: the Page says "In <neighbourhood>" with no street address, and Explore's map marks the area at its centre
Your own tag saves, there is no category list, and zero tags cannot publish
A public phone shows signed in but not signed out; a Page with nothing optional filled in still looks complete

title: Post an announcement with a time on it
role: the owner of your test Page
look: Edit works in place, no delete, and visitors see no edit
The time shows in local time; no date means no time, a Show-until field and "Posted <date>"; an undated post past its window sits under Earlier
The audience switch defaults to Anyone and says Nobody yet at zero
It reads as coming from the Page: no price, no buy button
After its start time passes it leaves Explore by itself

title: Follow a Page and unfollow it
look: Follow turns into following and the Page shows in your list
Unfollow then follow again: back once, no duplicate
Following a business when you own no shop still offers you Start something
The Page's Started by line and your Following list show display names, never a legal name

title: Add pictures to posts and see them everywhere
role: the owner of your test Page
look: One photo per post is kept; a second is refused with a message
The Page picture does not change when a post gets a photo
Each card shows one image: post photo, else Page picture, else placeholder
Reporting one image hides only that image and the card falls back to the next picture; the notice says which
Removing a picture and reloading: it is gone

title: Read one flagged post in full and remove its photo
look: Each row shows a picture, a short excerpt, how serious, the reasons, the AI line, the reply, the reporter's record, the status and age
Seriousness runs 1 to 4 and shows the highest open one; a pile-on from new accounts is flagged as possible coordinated reporting
Tap a row: its full history shows newest first, with Undo on any decision
Serious pictures are blurred until you press and hold; the most serious show plain
Remove photo on your test Page: it vanishes everywhere but the post stays listed; on Removed photos, deleting it for good cannot be undone

title: A second person's report hides the post
role: a second member (not the Page owner)
look: The first report leaves the post up and the owner gets a gentle notice
Reporting again from the same account does not hide it
A report from a different member hides it
Both reports appear in the review list, hidden or not
A sixth open report from one account is refused; after a dismissal the limit is one

title: Sign up with a zip from a city that is not open yet
look: A made-up zip is refused with a plain message
A zip from a waiting city puts you on that city's waitlist and names it
Nobody asks you to pick a city
In an open city your home town comes from the zip and nothing else
Change the zip on You: your city and town move with it

title: Narrow Explore and watch the search box
look: Tap Apply: the panel closes and your choices are written into the box in plain words
Edit those words by hand: the results follow what the box says
Clear the box: the narrowing is gone
Open a copy of the link: the same filters come back

title: Check the AI light and the Friday summary
look: A readiness light shows green, amber or red
The review page lists recall, top-severity recall, false alarms and shadow days against their targets
On a Friday, a summary shows waiting rows by seriousness, answers received and cool-downs started

title: Post a Wonder and watch neighbours join
role: the owner of your test Page, plus a second signed-in account
look: New post offers a Wonder: your words, a target number and an optional list of sizes
From the second account, tap I'm in and pick a size: the bar fills; change the size, then leave: the count drops
As the poster you see the count per size; the second account sees only the total and no names
From the second account, offer to help in a role; as the poster, accept it: the helper's display name and role show on the Wonder
Nothing on the Wonder asks for or promises money, and Report is on its menu
